5d7f61ae62.rewrite:

lea rdx,[rdx+0x10]
and rdx,0xfffffffffffffff0

5d7f61ae62.why: Subtract the original rdx from rcx before rounding rdx, then add the rounded value back, eliminating the temporary offset copy. The final mask and zero assignment preserve rax, rsi, and ZF.

46a8c3bea7.rewrite:

movaps xmm5,XMMWORD PTR [rcx+0x10]
movaps xmm6,XMMWORD PTR [rcx+0x20]
movaps xmm7,XMMWORD PTR [rcx+0x30]
movaps xmm2,xmm4
pminub xmm2,xmm5
pminub xmm2,xmm6
pminub xmm2,xmm7
pcmpeqd xmm2,xmm0
pmovmskb eax,xmm2
lea rdx,[rdx+0x40]
lea rcx,[rcx+0x40]
test rax,rax
46a8c3bea7.why: Unsigned byte minimum is associative, so one accumulator replaces the two partial reductions and removes one copy. Loading directly into xmm4 through xmm7 preserves all four live input vectors and leaves the same comparison result for ZF.
